item.title: Privacy
item.description:
Privacy Policy for Lazulite

Thank you for choosing Lazulite. Your privacy is important to us, and we are committed to safeguarding your personal data. This Privacy Policy outlines the types of information we collect, how we use it, and the measures we take to protect your data when you use our Android application available on the Google Play Store.

Website Analytics:

When you visit lazulite.app, we collect anonymized analytics about page visits and interactions with download links, setup resources, FAQ answers, and contact links. This analytics applies only to the website and is separate from the optional telemetry collected by the Android app. We do not use cookies or identify individual visitors. Analytics data is processed on servers in the European Union and retained only for as long as necessary to improve the site and its support content, and to meet applicable legal obligations, in accordance with applicable privacy laws.

Permissions & Setup

Why does Lazulite need special permissions?

Lazulite needs permission to read your Android system's audio logs to show you real-time codec information and Bluetooth transmission data. Android restricts access to these logs for privacy and security reasons, so you'll need to grant permission using one of three methods:

Option 1: Shizuku (Recommended for Most Users)

Best for: Most users, especially those who prefer to set up Lazulite directly on their phone

item.title: What's New
item.description:
2026.09

  • A refreshed Home screen makes your audio path easier to follow.
  • See which app is playing, with app icons shown on more Android devices.
  • More accurate LDAC decoding on OnePlus devices.
  • Share your preferences and feedback through an optional in-app questionnaire.

2026.08

  • See the complete audio path from the playback app to your Bluetooth device.
  • View the playback app’s output format, sample rate, bit depth, channels, and routing.
  • Spot possible sample-rate conversion.
  • Improved Bluetooth and playback detection.
  • Better support for Android 10, Android 12, and newer Android versions.
  • Fixed compatibility issues on API 29 and some Lenovo devices running API 33.
  • View A2DP Hardware Offload status and supported codecs.
  • Improved LHDC V5 and AAC bitrate decoding.
  • A clearer, redesigned onboarding experience.
  • Better guidance for Bluetooth, notification, and system-log access.
  • Automatic playback updates remain optional.
  • Choose between system, light, and dark themes.
  • Italian is now available.
  • Added a 5-second auto-refresh option.
  • Optionally look up the manufacturer of the connected audio device.
  • Share compressed diagnostic logs more easily.

2026.05

  • Improved Home screen details display.
  • Added an auto-refresh option.
  • Several decoder fixes, performance improvements, and app size optimizations.

2026.02

  • Improved app resilience when encountering errors.
  • Improved media handling.
  • Several bug fixes and other improvements.
